help.policies.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
help.policies.privacy.desc: Your personal data is collected solely for government service delivery. We follow IT Act 2000, DPDP Act 2023, and Government of Tamil Nadu data governance guidelines. Data is encrypted in transit and at rest.
help.policies.terms.title: Terms of Service
help.policies.terms.desc: By using TN Kuviyam, you agree to provide accurate information for government service applications. Misrepresentation may result in application rejection and legal action under applicable Indian Penal Code provisions.
help.policies.grievance.title: Grievance Redressal Policy
help.policies.grievance.desc: Citizens may file grievances for service delays, incorrect rejections, or officer misconduct. All grievances are acknowledged within 24 hours and resolved within the prescribed SLA (typically 7-15 working days).
help.policies.accessibility.title: Accessibility Statement
help.policies.accessibility.desc: TN Kuviyam is designed to meet WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards. We support screen readers, keyboard navigation, high-contrast modes, and bilingual Tamil/English content to ensure inclusive access.

about.initiatives.negp.title: National e-Governance Plan (NeGP)
about.initiatives.negp.content: Tamil Nadu has progressively aligned its e-Governance strategies in consonance with NeGP since its formulation in May 2006. TN Kuviyam extends this vision into a modern, unified citizen interface layer.
about.initiatives.csc.title: Common Service Centres (CSCs / Assisted Services Portal)
about.initiatives.csc.content: CSCs and Assisted Services Portal counters across rural and urban districts act as essential last-mile delivery networks, ensuring citizens are supported by assisted service operators.
about.initiatives.infrastructure.title: State Infrastructure Backbone
about.initiatives.infrastructure.content: Secured via high-speed Tamil Nadu State Wide Area Network (TNSWAN), State Data Centre (SDC), and State Resident Data Hub (SRDH) to ensure authenticated, real-time service orchestration.
